minutes_text:
SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  Minutes of Regular Meeting

  Wednesday, June 19, 2019
_________________________________________________________________
1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee Was called to order at
  10:00 AM on Wednesday, June 19, 2019.
  Members present: Chick Campo, Lorraine Missick, Scott Snider, George Borst and
  Bette Donovan
  Members absent: Terry Kistler
  Staff Present: Yvonne Duran, Recreation Coordinator
  Guests Present: Linda Hughes a La Verne resident and another resident by the
  name of Mike.
  It was moved and seconded to approve the minutes of the Wednesday, May 15,
  2019 meeting. Motion carried.
2. Guest Speaker: None

  Unfinished Business

3. Nutrition Program: The average was 38 meals served for the month of May. A new
  volunteer has been helping with the lunch program from Bonita High School.

4. Bingo Report: May: George will have an update at the next meeting. Bingo is
  currently averaging 58 players. Yvonne will be posting Bingo information on the
  City’s Facebook page. She also mentioned using the Bingo Bugle again for 3
  months.

5. Meals on Wheels: No report.

6. Account Balance: To date, account balance is $5,738.59.

7. Fee Schedule for Use of the Facilities: Bingo has not paid for April and May. Bridge
  has not paid and owes for the month of February.

8. Mt. SAC Classes: The new session of Mt. SAC courses are doing well. A new
  course, Sewing and Tailoring Part I and Part II, started this month. Another Drawing
  course has been added on Tuesdays. Decorative Art is not doing as well. All Mt.
  SAC courses are free.
   New Business

9. Upcoming Events:
  Wednesday, July 3rd – Special City Sponsored Lunch (Patriotic Theme), 11:30 AM
  Thursday, July 4th – Center & City Hall closed in observance of Independence Day
  Thursday, July 4th – Parade, Country Fair, and Fireworks Show at Roynon and
  Bonita High School
  Wednesday, August 15th – Special City Sponsored Lunch (Luau theme), 11:30 AM
  Wednesday, August 20th – Line Dancing Party, 1:00 PM

10. Facilities Report: Water fountain is done. The roof in the Senior Craft Room is
  being repaired.

11. Public Comments:
  Scott mentioned there will be an open house at Hillcrest on July 18th. They will have
  a new gallery exhibit in July and it’s titled “Small Homes, Big Life”.
  George gave an update on Golf. The attendance is down and it may be because of
  the closure of Sierra La Verne. They have only had 12 people in attendance, while
  they used to have an average of 20 participants. They are looking into moving to
  San Dimas when Sierra La Verne closes.

  Lorraine talked about the Volunteer Luncheon being successful and Brandon did an
  outstanding job.

12. Adjourn: The meeting was adjourned at 10:35 AM. Motion approved. The next
  meeting will be Wednesday, August 21, 2019 at 10:00 AM (July meeting is dark).
